item.title: NSF Graduate Research Fellowship Program Information Session September 9th at Noon.
item.description: The NSF GRFP provides 3 years of salary and tuition for Masters and PhD students in 30+ STEM fields. Rensselaer students earn this prestigious award every year. Seniors, and 1st year grad students (fall 2026) who are U.S. citizens or permanent residents are eligible. Email madige@rpi.edu for information or Register for the virtual information session: https://surveys.rpi.edu/jfe/form/SV_6L3FFwv0qCROrvE Come learn about the program and resources to support your application

item.title: Study Abroad & Exchange Welcome Back/Welcome!
item.description: Join Education Abroad as we welcome back the RPI students who studied abroad last semester and summer and welcome our new international exchange students here this fall from partner universities. Enjoy a slice of pizza and learn about study abroad firsthand from fellow students! Undergraduate students considering study abroad are especially encouraged to attend. Tuesday, September 8, 4:00-5:15, Bruggeman Room, CBIS. Contact: Karen Dvorak, Education Abroad Program Manager, dvorak2@rpi.edu.
item.author: Students

item.title: Lally AI Academy Applications Now Open
item.description: Have an AI idea you want to bring to life? The Lally AI Academy is a 30-day, hands-on sprint where student teams build and deploy live AI-powered products with a $500 budget, mentorship, and professional-grade tools. No coding background required! Teams must include at least one Lally or ITWS student. Applications for Cohort 2 close September 15. Apply Today!

item.title: A Page of Madness | The Silent Light
item.description: Date: Saturday, September 5, 2026 7:00 PM - TOPOS 2026 welcomes The Silent Light, performing their live score for Japanese director Teinosuke Kinugasa’s 1926 silent masterpiece A Page of Madness. In EMPAC’s theater, Michael Formanski (guitar, electronics) and Matt Hardy (drums) transform the cult classic into a collision of sound and cinematic unrest. One unforgettable performance only. Included with festival pass.

item.title: RPI Semiconductor CoLab Catalyst Seminar Series – September 2026
item.description: The RPI Semiconductor CoLab Catalyst Seminar Series brings together faculty, researchers, and industry partners to share ideas, highlight collaborations, and advance semiconductor and microelectronics innovation. The seminar on September 15th, at the Albany NanoTech Complex, features Rena Huang (RPI) and Amit Dikshit (AIM Photonics) in two 45-min talks and a networking break. Faculty and students are invited, registration is required, transportation is possible. Follow link for more information.

item.title: Division of Human Resources Professional Development Seminar- “RPI MAX: Setting Goals and Reviewing Results”
item.description: This seminar will establish the positive effect of transforming the traditional role of planner and evaluator solely from the people-leader to a shared responsibility between leader and direct report. Leaders will experience how to develop and use effective SMART goals to help them, and their employees track progress and accurately evaluate outcomes. In addition, the fundamentals of an impactful performance discussion and the three phased approach of RPI MAX will be explored.
